facts.text: Report holder STORA ENSO OYJ; evaluation subject is CLT by Stora Enso.
Floor and roof components in Type I and II construction (IBC), and roof and floor decks in Type III (interior floor decks only), IV and V; IRC use requires an engineered design.
Dry service only, with lumber moisture content below 16 percent.
Connections between wall panels, roof and floor panels, and other supports need complete detailing and design satisfactory to the code official, with fasteners specified by size, length and bearing.
In-plane shear values in Table 3 apply to roof and floor diaphragms, but 'the complete diaphragm designs have not been evaluated'.
Evidence listed: ICC-ES AC455, dated February 2019, editorially revised June 2020.
